stories.title: Independent Assessment of AI R&D Acceleration at Anthropic in October 2026
stories.reason: METR's independent, high-access assessment estimates Anthropic's internal capability growth has roughly doubled (1.9x AECI trend) since Oct 2025, with ~80% attributed to AI - a rare rigorously-caveated data point on AI self-improvement.
key_facts: METR ran Aug 12-Oct 29 2026, ~2.5 FTE, with internal benchmark/compute/headcount data and 15 staff interviews
AECI growth trend: 1.9x prior rate (95% CI 1.5-2.8x); sensitivity range 1.1x-2.9x
~80% of acceleration attributed to AI; compute growth ruled out as the driver
Anthropic held unilateral redaction rights and redacted the most informative evidence; no query access to unreleased models

stories.title: Hackers Target OpenSSH SSHole Flaw Within Hours of Disclosure, Gain Root on Honeypot
stories.reason: OpenSSH 'SSHole' auth bypass (CVE-2026-123158, CVSS 8.1) on Alpine/musl+no-PAM was exploited in the wild <9h after disclosure; root achieved on a honeypot.
key_facts: CVE-2026-123158, CVSS 8.1, fixed in OpenSSH 10.6p2
Oversized password (257-1024 bytes) forces hash failure returning '*', matching disabled-password accounts
Affects musl + PAM-disabled OpenSSH (default on Alpine); glibc/Dropbear unaffected
First exploitation attempt <9 hours post-CVE; root achieved on one honeypot from a Japan-geolocated IP

stories.title: CEO-spoofing scammers used AI to help steal more than $100 million, feds say
stories.reason: DOJ charges three men in an AI voice/image-spoofing CEO-fraud ring that moved ~$129M from real companies, including hospitals and banks - concrete dollar figures and a named, working attack technique (not a rumor).
key_facts: Prosecutors: ~$129M stolen via AI-spoofed CEO voice/video plus AI-spoofed 'lawyers'
Named victims include $5M Missouri hospital, $2.6M Rhode Island bank, $11.5M UK tech firm, $4.6M MA finance co, $5.2M FL pet-food co
3 defendants charged (money laundering, wire fraud, aggravated ID theft), up to 104 years combined exposure
Funds routed through US/EU/UAE/China accounts, then into crypto

stories.title: Malicious Browser Extensions Could Use Claude Dispatch to Run Code on Users' Computers
stories.reason: Working PoC shows a malicious/compromised browser extension on claude.ai can hijack Claude Desktop's Dispatch feature to run arbitrary commands (demoed via npm install -> Calculator launch); Anthropic is retiring Dispatch over the design, not a patch.
key_facts: Forever Security PoC: script on claude.ai opens Dispatch, sends prompts, auto-clicks 'Allow' every second, installs an npm package whose install script opens Calculator
Root cause: Dispatch accepts any signed-in claude.ai session despite no visible link to it
Reported May 14; Anthropic called it a duplicate of an internally-found issue on May 19
Anthropic is retiring Dispatch (target Oct 2026) rather than fixing the underlying design; Claude Code Remote Control/Cowork flagged as possibly similar, untested

stories.title: Researchers Bypass ChatGPT Lockdown Mode to Exfiltrate Chats Without User Interaction
stories.reason: Check Point researchers bypassed ChatGPT's Lockdown Mode (meant to block prompt-injection data exfiltration) via a sandboxed-iframe popup escape, enabling chat exfiltration and zero-click exfil in the desktop app; OpenAI patched it Sept 18.
key_facts: Bug: nested-frame trick reaches an unmodified popup() function, escaping the preview sandbox that Lockdown Mode relies on
Exploitable via crafted prompt, malicious custom GPT, or a shared chat; zero-click exfiltration demonstrated in the desktop app
Patched by OpenAI on 2026-09-18 after responsible disclosure; this is the public writeup

stories.title: Closed AI models dominate the price-performance frontier
stories.reason: Village's LLM Atlas shows open-weight models' share of price-performance-optimal budgets collapsed from 41% (June) to 3% (Oct 2026) - a concrete, falsifiable number on the open-vs-closed economics question that matters for model-choice decisions.
key_facts: 201 budgets from 1%-3x GPT-5's per-task cost; June: 19 frontier points (8 open); Oct: 21 points (5 open)
Open-weight best-buy share: 41% (June) -> 3% (Oct); historically ranged 6%-52% at quarter-ends since 2024
Closed dominance attributed to flagship distillation (Haiku 5.5 within 2 weeks of Opus 5.5) and whole-family price coverage

stories.title: Show HN: Stroq – a local audit of what your coding agent did and why
stories.reason: Stroq is a small but real running tool (Apache-2.0, 192 stars) that audits/guards coding-agent sessions for secret exfiltration via local hooks - matches the 'running code beats a description' and agent-security-tooling criteria directly.
key_facts: npx @stroq/cli audits last 30 days of agent sessions for leaked secrets (names only, never values)
stroq init installs hooks that block curl|sh patterns and secret-carrying outbound calls, confirm on repeated read-then-act commands
Also ships replay/sent/attack(36 known attacks)/console subcommands; claims no telemetry, no outbound calls from hooks
